hook.text: You changed your profile picture to support a cause. Did you accomplish anything? Critics call it slacktivism.

buildup.text: Malcolm Gladwell argued online activism is weak-tie: easy to join, easy to leave. Real change needs sacrifice.

discovery.text: But research shows slacktivism can be a gateway. People who share online are more likely to donate and volunteer.

twist.text: The danger isn't that people do too little. It's that they feel they've done enough by clicking 'share.'

climax.text: The Ice Bucket Challenge raised $115 million. Kony 2012 raised awareness but changed nothing on the ground.

punchline.text: A click can start a movement. Or end one.

quiz.question: What does research say about people who engage in online activism?
options: They're more likely to donate and volunteer
